mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spu (title, intro, link, status, user_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{productUrl}, #{status}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE spu SET title = #{title}, intro = #{description}, link = #{productUrl}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO spu_preview_img (spu_id, img_url, sort) VALUES
(#{item.spu_id}, #{item.img_url}, #{item.sort})

INSERT INTO spu_detail_img (spu_id, type, content, sort) VALUES
(#{item.spu_id}, #{item.type}, #{item.content}, #{item.sort})

INSERT INTO sku (spu_id, specs, price, stock) VALUES
(#{item.spu_id}, #{item.specs}, #{item.price}, #{item.stock})
mapper.select: SELECT img_url FROM spu_preview_img WHERE spu_id = #{productId} ORDER BY sort ASC
SELECT content FROM spu_detail_img WHERE spu_id = #{productId} AND type = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC
SELECT id, specs as specName, price, stock FROM sku WHERE spu_id = #{productId}

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.intro as description, s.link as productUrl, s.status, s.user_id as userId, s.create_time as createTime, s.update_time as updateTime, sh.shop_name as storeName, sh.shop_avatar as shopAvatar FROM spu s LEFT JOIN shop sh ON s.user_id = sh.user_id WHERE s.id = #{productId}
